title: Rain Day
notes: Outline, stage 3: "You wake up sick, or the weather kills the plan. Only the floor version is possible. This plants the question 'What can I still do?' The Resilience skill line itself opens in Phase 2." Claude's draft uses both: a head cold, and rain that cancels the shift.
Rest is never penalized (design rule 5). Resting on purpose is one of the floor versions today. Being sick is a real new fact, so It's a plan change is honest today.

tag.item: Resilience: What can I still do?

text: Rain on the window before the alarm. Your head is full of wet sand. A cold, the real kind, the kind with a fever behind it.
Ray texts at 6:12: "Rained out. No work today."
The plan for today was {ceiling}. That's off.
The question gets smaller. What can I still do?
